methods: fs.fu received-frame projection (visual shell/A.a4/A.aR construction stubbed)
dA.gf2 attack flag and iI summary rendering (text/CSS sinks stubbed)
c5.sd0 guardian display replacement (A.uy visual widget stubbed)
conclusions: All 42 guardian action rows have raw category guardians. Only categoryWeapons on 264/286 changes effective incoming category to weapons. No automatic miracle category is inferred from a guardian.

Attack flag is base.atk>0 or raw base category weapons or positive DTO atk; it is independent of effective-category override and may differ from arithmetic composed power in hypothetical addItem compounds.

Positive DTO atk overrides the base before ordered additions; zero/negative falls back to base ATK in the public arithmetic helper. Positive DTO hitRate overrides display; zero/negative displays base rate.
DTO mp/cp feed counterBoost2xMP/counterTakeCP item labels. They do not establish a guardian fee, current caster resource, payment, gift or retained-miracle policy.

The attack decoder defaults missing/noninteger targetPlayerId to 0, not null or the source player. A rendering-compatible input still needs explicit validated source/target semantics in the executable adapter.

fs.fu preserves provided source/reversed/guardian/model information for display; target selection and server event ordering are outside this helper. All guardian raw models reject ordinary manual-main initiation.
c5.sd0 replaces/clears an existing displayed guardian without validating summon restrictions or choosing a type. No independent guardian HP, weakness or idle weight is established.
limitations: Target selection,25 percent opportunity,10 percent departure,summon type draw,Earth/Moon candidate selection and server phase/queue are intentionally not executed or inferred.
Ordinary-single and compound cases are externally supplied hypothetical payloads used to test the public formula; they are not proof that a guardian selector generates those arrays.

The client decoder accepts some structurally invalid renderer inputs such as 0/unknown model IDs; an executable import must validate known IDs, nonempty shapes, source/target existence and its own closed effect scope.
The after-filter append mask is the raw append predicate with a supplied prefix; filter_prefix_is_legal must also be true before considering a complete response legal.
No DOM, Firebase, account, timer, game connection or Dart application startup runs. Renderer visuals are stubbed, not server transitions.
